files.file: fastapi, uvicorn, python-multipart, pillow, httpx, pytest
create_app(db_path, uploads_dir) factory: SQLite schema, CRUD API under /api/logs, validation, static/uploads serving
frontend page with form and log list
fetch-based create/list/edit/delete, error display, delete confirm
tmp db/uploads fixtures and image helpers

tests.test: pytest: 14 passed, isolated tmp db and uploads

commands_run.command: pip install fastapi uvicorn python-multipart httpx pytest pillow

design_decisions.decision: Edit is PUT multipart (description, remove_photo_ids, photos); rejected alternative: separate photo endpoints, for atomic validation.
Validated uploads buffered in memory (max 5 MB each, read in chunks and aborted at limit) instead of streaming to disk; simpler, bounded at 25 MB.
Run via "uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory"; no module-level app so importing never creates real db/uploads.
Unknown photo id on edit returns 422; oversize photo returns 413; Content-Length over 26 MB returns 413 in middleware.
Files deleted after DB commit; stored UTC ISO timestamps, displayed in local time by JS.

implementation.self_critique: Oversize multipart bodies under 26 MB are still parsed by Starlette (spooled to temp files) before the 5 MB check; no test for the 26 MB middleware. Frontend is untested in a browser.
